canals._comment: Four 1-tile water channels run from the ocean ring straight to the citadel walls (north, west, east, south) along the castle's centre column/row. The tile against each wall is a dock where water-type units deliver. Where a road crosses a canal it becomes a bridge (walkable by everyone, water flows under it).

terrain._comment: How units move: 'water' units stay on ocean/canal tiles (and bridges), 'any' cross everything (flyers, amphibians); every other unit is 'land' and may only cross water on a bridge. Invaders with flying: true count as 'any'.

portalZone._doc: Each corner is a 4×4 invasion zone: the 2×2 rift in the corner, its two sentinel towers curving around the exit tile (2 diagonal steps out). Nothing may be built inside.

coast._doc: Seeded coastline: each layout carves coves and bays into the island rim in the chosen style. maxDepth = tiles a bay may bite inland, roughness = 0..1 small-scale wobble, smoothPasses = passes that drown land tiles with 3+ water sides. keepCastle / keepRift = land always kept around the citadel and each rift zone. NONE is used by saves from before coastlines (their buildings never move). maxShare = most of the land a style may drown (bays shrink until they fit, so all thirteen sites still have room).

desc.en: Gentle curves, the most land to build on.
desc.tl: Banayad na kurba, pinakamaraming lupang mapagtatayuan.

desc.en: Deep bays and headlands on every side.
desc.tl: Malalalim na look at tangway sa bawat gilid.

desc.en: Ragged, deeply bitten coast; less room, more water for fishers.
desc.tl: Gutay-gutay at malalim na baybayin; mas maliit na lupa, mas maraming tubig para sa mangingisda.
